answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the oasis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, re-queued for a second panel. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The marble holds work receipts rather than names, so the vine of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
